name: PDF Metadata Viewer and Scrubber

seo.title: PDF Metadata Viewer and Scrubber — Browser-Local Tool
seo.meta_description: Inspect standard PDF document-info metadata and create a copy with common metadata fields cleared locally.

assumptions: The tool clears metadata accessible through the local PDF library and reports what it changed.
limitations: This is not forensic sanitization: incremental revisions, XMP packets, attachments or hidden content may remain depending on the file.
